notes: Input has empty locators, no study identifiers and no neutral description. The supplied replication report explicitly identifies the selected original claim and Model 5 contrast, allowing independent target identification. Original title verified against author manuscript title and authors; replication reference and claim summary match. Original manuscript does not print Cohen’s f² for this contrast; retained its printed OLS coefficient difference without conversion. Replication uses final analytic N=626, not interim stage 1 N=418; interim stage 1 values were p=.380 and f²=.00187. Final replication also prints coefficient difference -.100 (SE=.079). Original manuscript page numbering differs from published pagination; PDF and manuscript page references are given.
